description: The statsd module sends metrics to StatsD.

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: If the metric is of type gauge, change the value by delta. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: StatsD host (hostname or IP) to send metrics to. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: metric_prefix
parameters.description: The prefix to add to the metric. Default: ""

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on host which StatsD is listening on. Default: 8125

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: The transport protocol to send metrics over. Choices: "udp" ← (default) "tcp"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the check, only present makes sense. Choices: "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Sender timeout, only applicable if protocol is tcp. Default: 1.0

examples:
- name: Increment the metric my_counter by 1
  community.general.statsd:
    host: localhost
    port: 9125
    protocol: tcp
    metric: my_counter
    metric_type: counter
    value: 1

- name: Set the gauge my_gauge to 7
  community.general.statsd:
    host: localhost
    port: 9125
    protocol: tcp
    metric: my_gauge
    metric_type: gauge
    value: 7
